editorial:
Imagine stepping into the gritty streets of New York City where one man wants it all. You get to follow John Gotti, a flashy guy with a big personality who climbs the ladder of the Gambino crime family. It feels like a classic mob story where you see the power trips, the fancy suits, and the constant fear of being stabbed in the back. The vibe is heavy on the drama, showing how Gotti loved the spotlight almost as much as he loved the money, making him a target for both the police and his own people.

While the acting is solid and the costumes look great, the story moves a bit too fast at times, skipping over some of the finer details of the mob wars. However, if you love seeing how a powerful man eventually loses everything, you will enjoy this ride. It is a great choice for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart for Gotti when his own close friends and family members decide to flip and testify against him. After several trials and a lot of legal battles, he is finally convicted of racketeering and other crimes. You see him stripped of his power and sent to prison for the rest of his life. He dies behind bars, showing that no matter how famous or scary he was, the law finally caught up to him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true crime stories and mob movies.
